Overview

Each tool shows the percentages for winning, tying and equity which is the expected share of the pot.  

When a flop is displayed on the Holdem odds calculator, it will display outs and a screen showing the out cards and the "Draw odds" to getting one of the cards.
 
Holdem and Omaha use "Exhaustive Enumeration" meaning every outcome for a given scenario is evaluated.

Razz, Stud, and Eight or Better use Monte Carlo Simulation (aka random sampling) to handle the large number of possible outcomes.  The random sampling size can be adjusted to low (200,000), medium (500,000) or high (800,000) sample hands.

Users can "emulate" exhaustive calculations for Razz, Stud, and Eight or better which allows the same sample hands to be used for a given scenario each time that the same scenario is calculated.
